trigger: The caller wants to cancel an appointment they already have, or move an existing appointment to a different time.

steps.instruction: Establish whether they want to cancel the appointment altogether or move it to another time. Ask only if it is not already clear.

Ask for the phone number the appointment was made with, and nothing else in this turn; do not read it back yet, that is the next step. Skip only if the caller already dictated a number earlier in this call. NEVER ask for the caller's name anywhere in this flow: the phone number finds the appointments and the caller confirms which one is theirs.

Apply the phone read-back gate from your system prompt: read the number back once and END YOUR TURN with the question whether it is right, nothing else. This step is finished ONLY when the caller has answered; until then stay here and do nothing else. If they say it is wrong, read the corrected number back once more and wait again. Skip only if you already read this exact number back and the caller confirmed it earlier in this call.

YOU MUST CALL THE evolvo_find_appointments TOOL IN THIS STEP, then get the caller to confirm ONE appointment out loud BEFORE anything is changed. Actually call it - never guess, invent or recall an appointment. Call only after the caller has answered yes to the phone read-back, with the phone exactly as dictated and confirmed and phone_confirmed true; send no name. On confirm_phone_first nothing happened: read the number back, ask if it is right, end your turn, and after the yes call again with phone_confirmed true. Do not cancel or change anything in this step. THEN read the result: say the person each appointment is for, its weekday, date and time - never the doctor or any other detail. A record in state needs_reschedule is still a live appointment holding its slot: list it like any other, and if the caller wants a new time go straight to the move flow without marking it again. If found is true and count is 1: name that appointment and ask whether it is the one they mean, then wait for a clear yes. If count is more than 1: name them one at a time (person, weekday, date, time) and ask which they mean, then wait. If the caller names a date or person matching none of them, say in ONE sentence that there is nothing on that date, name the weekday, date and time of the appointments that DO exist on this number, ask whether they mean one of those, and wait. Never act on an appointment the caller did not explicitly confirm. If found is false: say in one sentence that there is no appointment on this number in the coming weeks and ask whether it might have been booked with a different phone number - never ask for their name instead. IF THE TOOL ERRORS, TIMES OUT, OR CANNOT BE REACHED: never mention a system, a tool, a technical problem or an error, never retry more than once, and NEVER end the call because of it - say in one sentence that a colleague will call back to sort it out, and carry on. This step is finished only when the caller has answered.

condition.condition: The caller explicitly confirmed one specific appointment from the list that was found for this phone number, and wants it cancelled altogether.

steps.instruction: YOU MUST CALL THE evolvo_manage_appointment TOOL IN THIS STEP. Actually call it - never tell a caller an appointment is cancelled without a successful call. Call once with action cancel, the same phone as the lookup, the ref AND date copied from the ONE line of the list the caller confirmed, appointment_confirmed true, and the reason in note if given. Answer confirm_appointment_first, ambiguous_appointment, ref_date_mismatch, not_found and appointment_not_found exactly as the tool's description instructs; nothing is cancelled on any of them, and never retry. THEN, if success is true, say in one short sentence that the appointment on that day has been cancelled and say what the returned note says; whether the time is free again comes ONLY from slot_released, as the tool's description defines it. IF THE TOOL ERRORS, TIMES OUT, OR CANNOT BE REACHED: never mention a system, a tool, a technical problem or an error, never say the appointment was cancelled, and NEVER end the call because of it - say in one sentence that a colleague will call back to sort it out and carry on. Finish this step by asking once whether there is anything else you can help with, and wait for the answer.

condition.condition: The caller explicitly confirmed one specific appointment from the list that was found for this phone number, and wants to move it to a different time.

steps.instruction: IN THIS STEP YOU MUST CALL THREE TOOLS IN ORDER, AND THE STEP IS NOT FINISHED UNTIL THE THIRD HAS SUCCEEDED: first evolvo_manage_appointment, then evolvo_check_availability, then evolvo_book_appointment. Mark first, book second, and never invent availability. FIRST call evolvo_manage_appointment once with action reschedule, the same phone as the lookup, the ref AND date of the ONE line the caller confirmed, appointment_confirmed true, and note set to roughly when the caller would prefer instead; answer confirm_appointment_first, ambiguous_appointment or ref_date_mismatch as the tool's description instructs. SECOND call evolvo_check_availability for the same doctor as the confirmed appointment (any branch unless the caller wants the same one), with date_from set to the period the caller asked for or omitted. THEN offer ONE day with one or two free times, once, and WAIT for the answer - nothing is booked yet. If the caller declines, offer at most one alternative from the result. Do not ask which branch they prefer unless nothing is free with that doctor. THIRD, THE MOMENT the caller accepts a specific day and time, call evolvo_book_appointment in that same turn, before saying anything else, and do NOT ask about anything else, end this step or let the procedure finish until it has returned success true. Send slot_accepted true, phone_confirmed true, full_name from the person field of the confirmed appointment (never ask the caller for it), THE SAME confirmed phone as the lookup, the accepted slot's date, time, doctor and location, and problem 'reschedule of the appointment on <old date>'; answer offer_slot_first as the tool's description instructs. THEN say the outcome once, as the tool's description instructs for replaced_appointment, for the reminder and for booking_mode. If no new slot could be offered, the caller refused all of them, or the booking did not succeed, say in one sentence that the old appointment is marked for rescheduling and still holds its slot, and a colleague will call back to fix the new time; NEVER say the new time is booked or registered without success true, and never cancel the marked appointment as a tidy-up. Never retry a failed call more than once. IF ANY OF THE TOOLS ERRORS, TIMES OUT, OR CANNOT BE REACHED: never mention a system, a tool, a technical problem or an error, and NEVER end the call because of it - use the same sentence about a colleague calling back, and carry on. This step is finished ONLY when evolvo_book_appointment has returned success true, or the caller has refused every time you offered, or the lookup could offer nothing at all. Finish it by asking once whether there is anything else you can help with, and wait for the answer.

condition.condition: No appointment was found for this phone number, the lookup failed or could not be reached, or the caller said that none of the appointments found is theirs.

steps.instruction: Say in one sentence that a colleague will call back to sort it out. Do not guess which appointment was meant. If the caller instead says to leave everything as it is, skip the callback: say one short farewell and end the call.

Ask for the caller's full name and nothing else in this turn, and wait for the answer; it is only written down for the colleague who will call back. Skip if they already said their name in this call. Never continue with a placeholder such as necunoscut, ismeretlen or unknown.

YOU MUST CALL THE evolvo_log_request TOOL IN THIS STEP, but only if the caller still wants help with it. Actually call it - never claim a request has been passed on without a successful call. The phone number is already confirmed in this call: do not ask for it again and leave phone and phone_confirmed out, it is reused automatically. Call once with request_type callback, patient_name set to the real name the caller just gave, language set to the language of this call, and summary as one or two plain sentences for a colleague in that language: that the caller wants to cancel or move an appointment, the date they mentioned, and that no matching appointment could be found on this phone number. THEN, if success is true or duplicate is true, say in one sentence that the request has been passed on and a colleague will call them back. If success is not true, never say it was passed on. IF THE TOOL ERRORS, TIMES OUT, OR CANNOT BE REACHED: never mention a system, a tool, a technical problem or an error, never retry more than once, and NEVER end the call because of it - give them the branch's direct phone number and opening hours from your knowledge base instead, and carry on. Finish this step by asking once whether there is anything else you can help with, and wait for the answer.
